title: Other UFO-nuclear witnesses

tellings.quote: I'm not the only one only witness to these incidents involving UFOs and nuclear weapons. There are many many out there, including Dave Chandel,

plain: Many people besides Robert Salas say they saw UFOs show up around nuclear weapons. Salas, a former Air Force officer who says he witnessed such an incident himself, tells Michels he is not the only one, and names Dave Chandel and Walter Feel among them. His point is that the story does not rest on one man's word.
